descriptionText: This 1989 Topps Baseball card features Tim Belcher, a former Major League Baseball player for the Los Angeles Dodgers. The card is a part of the 1989 Topps set and has the card number 456. It is a sports trading card of the type "Sports Trading Card" and is not autographed. The card showcases Belcher as a rookie, making it a must-have for any collector interested in his career. The season the card represents is 1989, and it is categorized under "Trading Card Singles" and "Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop."
